title: An Abstract Index Theorem via Rees Algebras
summary: We develop a purely algebraic framework for index-type theorems based on the Rees construction for filtered differential graded algebras (FDGAs). Alongside the classical Rees module we introduce a smooth variant $C^ω_{\mathcal{R}}A$, adapted to analytic arguments, and we study traces and their pointwise and coefficient-wise extensions to Rees algebras.
